authority: skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/SKILL.md (thin router) · this file is routing metadata only

routing_conditions.condition: AR_SPAWN_ROLE is set by the hosted-seat control plane
routing_conditions.fail_closed_when: the value has no matching roles/<value>.md, or the role env arrives without its matching plane-injected hosted-session identity

routing_conditions.condition: the first user message is a templates/*-brief.md-shaped dispatch or a first line of the form 'ROLE BRIEF - <role>'
routing_conditions.fail_closed_when: the named role has no matching roles/<role>.md

routing_conditions.condition: no spawn-role env, no role brief: a developer opened this session
routing_conditions.note: a distinct routing condition, not a role; the launcher dispatches a real role seat instead of taking one

orientation.purpose: Opening a turn: read the brief and its durable inputs, establish trust facts, state the current state back.

planning.purpose: Deciding what will be built: reframing, evidence-backed design, requirement compilation, topology, plan review.

implementation.purpose: Building the assigned scope inside the leaf worktree and producing the builder artifacts.

review.purpose: The requested independent review seam and its exact baseline / fix-verification mode contract.

curation.purpose: The leaf coherence pass: reconcile intended, current, and implemented meaning and write affected onboarding.

coordination.purpose: Driving a portfolio or master-series from durable state, including the targeted-check contract closeout consumes.

authorized-closeout.purpose: The authorized Git code/memory transaction and the targeted-check contract it consumes.

recovery.purpose: Resuming, resyncing, repairing, or retiring a run whose state moved: the bounded recovery moves.

bootstrap.purpose: The new user's first hour: the memory repository from nothing to a resolving context, and the failure states a new user actually hits.

authority.purpose: Seat authority, seat binding, immutability, the dispatch transaction, takeover, the escalation ladder, clarification triage, delegated series authority, the decision relay.

invariants.purpose: The shared invariants every role can count on, the task-doc/branch/worktree spine, default behavior, knob resolution, instruction-surface boundaries.

lifecycle-frame.purpose: The minimal lifecycle frame: the six signals, which seats run them, the trust checkpoint, provider-degradation handling.

loop.purpose: The three-party loop doctrine, tiers, rounds and convergence, criteria catalogs, per-level agent sets, requirement compilation before topology.

acceptance.purpose: Completion truth vs acceptance, the per-seat handoff artifact table, per-ID acceptance envelopes, attempt lineage, the durable-evidence promotion hold point.

launcher.purpose: The ambient launcher's own obligations, authored here so the role registry holds only roles.

architect.seat: developer-facing owner seat; design conversation, decision-item relay, and drawing board

orchestrator.seat: sprint-local spawned backend portfolio and orchestration seat; never developer-facing

designer.seat: a HAT the architect pulls inline, or an optional separate sprint chair; evidence-backed problem framing at the assigned scope

strategist.seat: the sprint planner, spawn-first under the architect's propose-first question; reader, not mutator

manager.seat: sprint-local coordination seat per master; drives exactly one master's leaf loop

worker.seat: one leaf worktree, short-lived, fresh session; the builder with a no-commit contract

curator.seat: fresh per leaf after builder and (when requested) reviewer; writes onboarding only

reviewer.seat: short-lived adversarial reviewer at the requested seam; verdicts are evidence, not decisions

system-specialist.seat: provider-degradation investigator; report first, fixes only after an explicit orchestrator order

bootstrap.seat: the new user's first-hour seat; sets one repository up through the surfaces that own each step and reports what actually happened

rationale.description: Reference-only: rationale, provenance, and credits consolidated out of the normative path.

rulings.description: Reference-only: durable developer rulings and the superseded rules they replace, with citations.

lenses.description: The four job lenses the scoping seats read. Reference material for the architect, orchestrator, and designer; a dispatched role never picks a lens.

criteria.description: The reviewer criteria catalogs, bound per review type by operations/review.md and roles/reviewer.md.

templates.description: Field schemas for dispatch briefs and handoff artifacts, and the plan/report template library for the seats that compile them.

notes: Routing metadata only: this file carries no instruction prose and no copies of any source section.
Exactly one source per instruction. core/ is authored once; a role file states its own seat's side of a shared rule and never restates the whole of it.
Task facts are a separate context channel and are not part of this manifest.
The launcher is a routing condition, not a role: the role registry is exactly the entries in role_order.
